newsitem.title: CHINA: China opens its largest wharf for processed oil.
newsitem.headline: China opens its largest wharf for processed oil.

text.p: China's largest wharf for handling processed oil started formal operation last month at the northeastern port of Dalian in Liaoning province, officials said on Monday.
The wharf can export 3.85 million tonnes of processed oil and 120,000 tonnes of liquefied petroleum gas a year and import 17,000 tonnes of methanol a year, officials said.
The project cost 360 million yuan to build and serves as part of a refinery with annual output capacity of five million tonnes in Dalian, where the Liaohe oilfield is located, officials said.
However, the wharf had yet to be fully used because the refinery had yet to reach its capacity output.
The wharf had been in trial operation since September 28 last year, one official said.
